risk_if_not_implemented: Without Automated De-Identification of Sensitive / Regulated Data, inaccurate, stale, corrupted or manipulated data may drive flawed decisions and control failures. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6). No threat is rated Likely for this control; threats rated Possible include Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Protection
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of data protection controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Protection (DCH-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Automated De-Identification of Sensitive Data (DCH-36.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
